title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：yard　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 yard 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the grandmother ① sweeped the yard that no child in the courtyard would have measured, and he said the sweeping was the whole of the year. The ② yard, meaning the ground itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; a yard, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ yard in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ yard at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A yard, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the grandmother said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the yard was the whole of the matter, meaning the space and not the ground. The ⑥ yard, meaning the space and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; yard, he said, is either something you sweep or the only word that means both a ground and a space. He said the space is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ yard had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ yard of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of measuring; yard, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ yard I remember is the ground measured in the diary, which closed in 1977 and is still measured as the quietest in the courtyard. A ⑩ yard, my mother said in 1979, is the only ground that improves by being measured; every yard, she said, is a space that has agreed to look like a ground. She said the space was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 院子；码（指院子里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 院子；码（指那个院子本身，与小小的灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：sweep the yard 扫这一个院子
D. n. 院子；码（指留给孩子们守着的那一件）
E. n. 院子之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的院子之事）
F. n. 院子；码（指日记里写到、被测量的那一个）
G. n. 院子、天地（指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 天地（抽象总称，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: sweeped the yard that no child in the courtyard would have measured
The yard, meaning the ground itself and not the lamp
the yard at the far window
the yard was the whole of the matter
the yard had become a line in a diary
The yard of the whole thing
A yard, my mother said in 1979

answers.why: sweep the yard 意为“扫这一个院子”，1970 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯测量的一个院子做了一遍。
yard 意为“院子；码”，指那个院子本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被测量。
yard 意为“院子；码”，指院子里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
yard 意为“院子；码”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
yard 意为“院子、天地”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个天地就是那件事的全部。
yard 意为“天地”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个院子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
yard 意为“院子；码”，指日记里写到、被测量的那一个，到 1975 年这一个成了日记里的一行。
yard 意为“院子之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的院子之事是一处院子和三个年头的测量。
yard 意为“院子；码”，我记得的是日记里测量过的那一个，1977 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一个。
yard 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，院子是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的院子。
